prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Make an iPad document comparator retain state across multitasking changes. Read interface.md. input_files.interface.md: Platform: iPadOS. App closes when its window becomes narrow, clears edits on backgrounding and starts audio unexpectedly on return. Two documents should remain independently editable in separate windows where supported.
